fields.FIR_Description: During the early morning of 2025-12-23, around 06:45, the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 1,500) after boarding a crowded bus near Vaigai Layout Market Road, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-23. Contact details given by the complainant, Deviga Krishnan, include the number 9000000040. The complaint mentions Murugan Sundaram, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000207, in connection with the events. Revathi Raman (9000000145), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. Kishore Muthu (9000000320) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement, CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly bumped into the victim while another person took the purse.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, mobile number, CCTV, witness statement, suspect, early morning, associate
